'''Delquis''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[Corellian Council]]. During the [[Galactic War]], Delquis planned on saving [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] if he and the members of the council would serve the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], he was present when [[the Barsen'thor]] was searching for the [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]]. He was brutally killed by Councilor [[Saiak]], who was revealed to be a [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]].
